## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at Museum of Communism, V Celnici 1031/4, 118 00 Praha 1-Nové Město, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Museum of Communism. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This audio tour is perfect for those intrigued by the intersection of history and architecture in the heart of Europe. With your ticket to the Museum of Communism included, set off on a self-guided exploration that reveals Prague's enchanting layers. Note that while entry to the Museum of Communism is provided, an immersive audio tour of the museum's interior is not included in this experience - you will have a live guide.
> Beginning at the stark yet informative Museum of Communism, listeners will embark on an enlightening stroll to the grand Hradčany Square outside the gates of the iconic Prague Castle. Along the way, the voices of Gothic cathedrals, bustling squares, and poignant monuments will weave a rich narrative fabric that beckons exploration. You'll traverse from the echoes of communism to the whispers of cobblestoned alleyways, all culminating in the regal presence of Prague Castle. On your journey, stand face-to-face with silent giants of stone, march the Royal Route of medieval kings, and stand in the very places where monumental changes in Czech history unfurled.
>
> End on a high note by reveling in the majestic Hradčany Square, which foretells the stories of might and grandeur of the Prague Castle. Through this tour, experience a mosaic of sensory details that bring the city's heritage to life - the vibrant colors of Golden Lane, the soul-stirring chimes of the Astronomical Clock, and the haunting narratives spun within the walls of St. Vitus Cathedral.
